decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive Mono Blue Aggro strategy. The deck focuses on using low-cost spells like Mental Note, Deep Analysis, Snap, and Brainstorm to quickly fill the graveyard and reduce the cost of Cryptic Serpent. Delver of Secrets serves as an early threat, while Counterspell and Spell Pierce provide control and disruption. Thought Scour and Tolarian Terror enable further card draw and graveyard manipulation. Murmuring Mystic adds token generation, and Lose Focus and Consider offer additional situational control. Lórien Revealed likely serves as a sideboard option for specific matchups.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a mix of countermagic, removal spells, and creature evasion. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells and removing threats from the board. The deck also utilizes card draw and manipulation to maintain card advantage and ensure it has the resources needed to control the game. The win conditions include efficient beaters like Gurmag Angler and Thorn of the Black Rose, as well as evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost instants and sorceries to quickly fill the graveyard and enable the powerful effects of cards like Cryptic Serpent, Murmuring Mystic, and Tolarian Terror. It aims to maintain control and disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal while also applying pressure with creatures like Delver of Secrets. The deck also includes draw spells like Thought Scour, Brainstorm, and Frantic Inventory to ensure consistent card advantage. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive play, efficient use of spells, and capitalizing on the graveyard as a resource.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using gate cards and powerful removal spells. The deck focuses on building a strong board presence with creatures like Sacred Cat and Thraben Inspector, while also utilizing the gate cards to generate additional value. Prismatic Strands and Guardian of the Guildpact provide protection against opposing threats, while Scrapwork Mutt and Unearth offer additional recursion options. This control deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent through careful resource management and efficient removal spells such as Cast Down and Crypt Rats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through powerful spells such as Counterspell and Journey to Nowhere, while also utilizing Gates cards for additional value. The deck aims to stall the game with cards like Prismatic Strands and Squadron Hawk until it can establish a strong board presence with creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Dawnbringer Cleric. The deck also includes card draw and deck manipulation with Preordain and Brainstorm to ensure consistent plays and maintain control over the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells while maintaining control of the board through counterspells and bounce effects. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on with cards like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force Spike and Spell Pierce. By combining aggression with control elements, the deck seeks to close out games swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the affinity mechanic and aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By playing cheap artifacts like Myr Enforcer, Frogmite, and Gearseeker Serpent, the deck can easily reduce their casting cost. Additionally, cards like Thoughtcast and Chromatic Star provide card draw and mana fixing. The deck also includes interaction through Metallic Rebuke, Cast Down, and Makeshift Munitions. The land base is optimized with artifact lands like Seat of the Synod and Vault of Whispers, along with a variety of bridges for additional synergy. Overall, the deck focuses on speed, efficiency, and leveraging artifacts for victory.

The main focus of this deck is to play efficient and cheap spells to control the game while also being aggressive. By using cards like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, the deck aims to apply early pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force Spike and Spell Pierce. The inclusion of deep card draw with cards like Thought Scour and Deep Analysis allows for consistency in finding necessary cards to win the game. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and control.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with a combination of counterspells and removal spells, while also generating card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Augur of Bolas. Spellstutter Sprite and Faerie Seer provide early game defense and help maintain control of the board. The deck finishes off opponents with efficient threats like Gurmag Angler and Ninja of the Deep Hours. The mana base is designed to ensure consistency in casting spells, with a mix of Islands, Swamps, and unique lands like Contaminated Aquifer and Lórien Revealed.

This deck focuses on using artifacts and creatures with affinity for artifacts to quickly generate a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. It includes cards like Myr Enforcer and Gearseeker Serpent that have reduced mana costs based on the number of artifacts you control. The deck also includes artifacts like Ichor Wellspring and Chromatic Star to draw additional cards and provide mana fixing. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Metallic Rebuke and Cast Down to control the opponent's threats. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to quickly develop a board and overwhelm the opponent with efficient and powerful artifacts and creatures.

This deck focuses on maintaining control of the board through counterspells and removal spells while generating card advantage with cards like Mulldrifter and Augur of Bolas. It aims to outvalue opponents by constantly drawing cards and denying their plays with counterspells. The inclusion of snow-covered lands allows for efficient removal with Skred, while cards like Ephemerate and Archaeomancer provide additional value and recursion. The deck also includes various win conditions like Murmuring Mystic and Lórien Revealed to close out the game once the opponent has been sufficiently controlled.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and utilizing cheap artifacts to power up creatures with All That Glitters. With a low mana curve, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and counter spells like Metallic Rebuke to protect its board state. Thoughtcast and Of One Mind provide card draw to maintain momentum, while Moon-Circuit Hacker acts as a finisher. The deck's synergies exploit the affinity mechanic and efficient card draw to create a fast and aggressive strategy in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, card draw, and counter spells. By using efficient removal like Snuff Out and Gurmag Angler, alongside powerful card draw spells like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour, the deck aims to out-value and out-last opponents. Unexpected Fangs provides additional utility, while Spell Pierce and Counterspell offer protection against threats. Lórien Revealed serves as a win condition, with Fallaji Archaeologist providing recursion for crucial spells. The deck also includes land manipulation with Terramorphic Expanse and evolving wilds.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to maintain control over the game by utilizing counter spells, removal, and card advantage through drawing and bouncing creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats like Gurmag Angler and Thorn of the Black Rose to finish the game. With a mixture of card draw, graveyard interaction, and removal spells, the Dimir Control deck aims to out-value the opponent and grind them down to secure victory in the long game.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through removal spells and creature abilities, while also generating value with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Llanowar Visionary. Golgari and Jund cards are utilized to create a strong defensive strategy with cards like Chainer's Edict and Crypt Rats, while also providing a way to generate additional creatures with Khalni Garden. The deck aims to out-value and outlast the opponent through card advantage and resilient threats like Thorn of the Black Rose and Avenging Hunter, while also maintaining a steady mana base with Golgari Rot Farm and efficient removal spells like Cast Down and Defile.
